description: Na₆Mg(SbO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.41 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.40 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.42 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one SbO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SbO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.41 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one SbO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SbO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.38 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SbO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to five O atoms to form SbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.01 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.01 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₅Sb octahedra that share corners with three ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, edges with three ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Sb octahedra, corners with three ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Sb octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 32°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Sb octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Sb octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, and edges with two ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, corners with five ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Sb octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Sb octahedra, corners with three ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₅Sb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 76°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom to form ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, corners with two ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Sb octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom to form ONa₂MgSb trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Sb octahedra, corners with three ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgSb tetrahedra, and edges with two ONa₄Sb trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-51°.
